author: Kuhn & Rueß GmbH
name: Git Repository
description: Git repository reached over HTTPS, e.g. for Rules in Git

account_custom_field_help.branch: Branch that is read and written. A branch that does not exist yet is created by the first push.
account_custom_field_help.path: Folder inside the repository the files go to. Empty uses the root of the repository.
account_custom_field_help.verify_cert: False accepts a self signed certificate of the Git server.
account_custom_field_help.rule_types: Rules in Git cronjob: comma separated rule types it pulls, e.g. cmk_rules, cmk_filter. Empty pulls every rule type found in the repository.
account_custom_field_help.delete_missing: Rules in Git cronjob: True deletes the rules of a pulled type that are not in the repository, so the type matches the repository exactly.
